title: Maya and the Golden Casters
logline: When a flash flood turns her town into a series of rushing canals, a determined young wheelchair user must engineer a floating catamaran rig to race downstream and retrieve her dream caster wheels before the post office closes.

beats.title: The Golden Goal
beats.summary: Maya wakes up excited to collect her limited-edition gold-plated titanium caster wheels from the Riverdale Post Office.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya transfers from her bed to her lightweight manual wheelchair with ease, showing her daily routine and physical independence.

beats.title: The Flood Alert
beats.summary: Maya rolls to the window and discovers a flash flood has turned the street into a rushing river, and the mail truck leaves at five.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya uses her wheelchair to navigate her room and quickly grabs her toolkit from under her seat.

beats.title: The Neighbor's Doubt
beats.summary: Her neighbor Leo yells from his porch, thinking they are stuck, but Maya is already planning a way through the water.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya rejects Leo's offer to call for help, wanting to get her package herself using her own skills.

beats.title: The Catamaran Blueprint
beats.summary: Maya designs a floating rig using an old surfboard and heavy-duty straps from the garage.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya uses her deep engineering knowledge of wheel dynamics and low center of gravity to design the rig.

beats.title: The Build
beats.summary: Maya clamps her wheelchair onto the surfboard, securing it tightly with her favorite wrench.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya's wheelchair is treated as her personal space and a piece of high-tech machinery that she modifies herself.

beats.title: The Launch
beats.summary: Maya rolls down her porch ramp and splashes into the rushing water, floating perfectly.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya uses her wheelchair's main wheels as paddlewheels to propel herself through the floodwater.

beats.title: Rushing Downstream
beats.summary: Maya navigates the currents, enjoying the speed and steering with precision.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya uses her upper-body strength and precise wheel-braking to steer the floating craft.

beats.title: The Log Jam Obstacle
beats.summary: A giant fallen oak branch blocks the canal, threatening to capsize her or stop her progress.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya utilizes her spinal cord injury balance techniques to prepare for a risky maneuver.

beats.title: The Leap
beats.summary: Maya pops a wheelie on her floating rig, shifting her weight to slide over the log safely.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya's physical capability and wheelchair control allow her to clear the obstacle where others would fail.

beats.title: The Post Office Reach
beats.summary: Maya arrives at the post office just as the mail truck is about to leave, and she makes her landing.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya transfers from her floating rig onto the dry concrete steps of the post office.

beats.title: The Upgrade
beats.summary: Maya gets her package and uses her wrench to install the golden casters right on the spot.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya upgrades her own wheelchair, demonstrating her role as the engineer of her own mobility.

beats.title: The Golden Roll
beats.summary: Maya rolls down the dry sidewalk, her new golden wheels gleaming in the sun.
beats.trait_in_play: Maya is a wheelchair user in the final scene, moving fast, independent, and proud of her achievement.

trait_causality_note: Maya's spinal cord injury and daily experience as a wheelchair user give her the specific upper-body balance and wheel-propulsion physics required to navigate the unstable floating catamaran and jump the log barrier.
